headline: Binance Secures $6.5 Billion Freezing Order Against Hackers
summary: Crypto exchange Binance has obtained a $6.5 billion court order to freeze assets linked to a major theft. The company stated it has already reimbursed affected users using its own capital and insurance reserves.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Security breaches and the subsequent recovery of funds are critical to maintaining institutional trust and regulatory compliance in the digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Successful recovery of stolen funds and legal action against hackers improves the exchange's operational security profile.
